# Module 11 — collections, part 1

Allowed: modules 1–10, plus `List`, `ArrayList`, `LinkedList`, `Set`, `HashSet`, and `Iterator`.

Do not suggest or require: `Map`, `TreeSet`, `Comparable`, `Comparator`, `Collections.sort`, regular expressions, lambda expressions, method references, `Optional`, the Date-Time API, the Stream API, threads, files, or web APIs.

Do not ask to replace a loop over a list or set with a stream.
